status: fixed post-hoc generation-aligned target correction; not preregistration or independent confirmation

frame.selection: all requested items in original frozen manifest order; numeric/confidence historical strict parser, existing construction exclusion and frozen answer label eligibility; do not restrict to old1735 or select by correctness

generation_equivalence.basis: original answer fields only, before correctness labels; exact Decimal equality using frozen numeric parsing
generation_equivalence.missing: old or new original numeric answer cannot be recovered/parsed; keep field hashes and unknown metadata; no correctness filtering
generation_equivalence.unit_confidence: record separately, not change equivalence definition

labels.authorized_gold: FinQA TRAIN top-level id and qa.answer for requested IDs only
labels.rule: frozen V3.1/v3.2 label_policy.py parse_numeric/label_one verbatim; no tolerance, percent scaling or parser changes

features.G96: original-side input plus current three-world Qwen original response, frozen feature_builder _graph/_safe; never substitute old Qwen response
features.raw17_curve33: same saved parser/arithmetic/order and finite nonsharing requirements
features.safe_failure: mark invalid/unknown without synthesizing success or old-generation fallback

training.folds: GroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=False) on exact source_group in new full eligible queue; folds are newly constructed post-hoc and may differ from old

evaluation.primary: new labels/new G/new full queue; AUROC/AP; Full-Raw and Full-Graph plus three predefined family-removal contrasts
evaluation.common_items: IDs intersect old1735 and new strict queue, original row matching; old OOF with old/new labels and new OOF with new labels; all/common/added/old-only supports. Differences between trained runs are not isolated label/G/coverage causal effects.
